text: Bitcoin's modest 2.1% pullback contrasts with Ethereum's sharper 5.6% drop, signaling weaker conviction in altcoins during this retreat. Fear & Greed at 29 reflects genuine risk-off sentiment that has intensified over the week, though $60B in daily volume suggests traders remain engaged rather than absent. Bitcoin's dominant 60.2% grip indicates capital is rotating toward perceived safety, a typical pattern when broader risk appetite deteriorates.
